data.name: Josephine
data.gender_notes: Josephine is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of Joseph, from the Hebrew Yosef, 'he will add'. Its root is Hebrew y-s-p. A Christian name; borne by Saint Josephine Bakhita. Josephine is a Hebrew name meaning “He will add; God increases”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Josephine expresses “He will add; God increases”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of Joseph, from the Hebrew Yosef, 'he will add'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Josephine total 47, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
